Everything contributed to the success of our family holiday: consistently favorable winds for kitesurfing, a prime location on the beach near the protective mangroves, and a property large enough to allow for freedom of movement—unlike the other, much more cramped lodges on the beach; personalized service expertly orchestrated by the housekeeper; varied, delicious, and plentiful food; a warm and friendly atmosphere where the owner and his family, other guests, staff, and their children mingle; qualified, smiling, and passionate instructors; appreciable comfort (hot water available, rooms cleaned at least once a day, spacious family bungalow); and architecture that is both refined and respectful of its environment. Kiteboarding novices (like us) will find just as much to enjoy as the pros. In this regard, the unlimited package is more than just a plus: firstly, because starting out in kitesurfing takes much longer than the ten hours offered by other providers in the bay, secondly, because it removes a mental burden you don't need in addition to the stress inherent in learning :) In short, it's easy to see why a good portion of the clientele returns year after year!<!--
